name: YourWay Cannabis Brands Inc.
summary: YourWay Cannabis Brands Inc. functions as a multi-state operator within the cannabis industry, conducting active sales and managing operations across Arizona and California. The company employs a diverse approach, cultivating its proprietary brands, forming alliances with other businesses, and providing white-label products. These initiatives are geared towards broadening market penetration, transforming the cannabis sector, and reimagining the interaction between consumers and cannabis brands. This organization was previously recognized as Hollister Biosciences Inc. before officially rebranding to YourWay Cannabis Brands Inc. in December of 2021. Established in 2019, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in Phoenix, Arizona.
